pred_sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934
SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero AS s INNER JOIN colour AS e ON s.eye_colour_id = e.id INNER JOIN colour AS h ON s.hair_colour_id = h.id WHERE e.colour = 'Blue' AND h.colour = 'Blond'
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND T2.colour = 'No Colour'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180

SELECT T1.client_id, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.birth_date) AS age FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id WHERE T3.type = 'gold' AND T2.type = 'OWNER'
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Male' AND T1.weight_kg > (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) * 0.79 FROM superhero)

SELECT attribute.attribute_name, hero_attribute.attribute_value FROM hero_attribute INNER JOIN superhero ON hero_attribute.hero_id = superhero.id INNER JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE superhero.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id) AS hero_count FROM hero_power AS hp INNER JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Stealth'

SELECT T1.positionOrder FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T1.driverId = T3.driverId WHERE T2.year = 2008 AND T2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton'
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'

WITH acc AS (SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY l.loan_id LIMIT 1), b1 AS (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM acc) AND t.date = '1993-03-22' ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1), b2 AS (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM acc) AND t.date = '1998-12-27' ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (CAST(b2.balance AS REAL) - b1.balance) * 100.0 / b1.balance AS increase_rate FROM b1, b2

SELECT CAST(SUM(Match.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id) AS avg_home_team_goal FROM Match JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Poland' AND Match.season = '2010/2011'
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes) LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS budget_ratio FROM budget AS b INNER JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
